response: Folks, look at what’s happening over there with Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan trying to push through a Rs 700 crore common software project via the Cooperative Department. They want us to believe this is all about building collective infrastructure, but let's be honest about what’s really going on when massive state spending and bureaucratic centralization get involved. On Saturday, Mar 28, Vijayan came out swinging against critics, dismissing serious allegations of corruption as a smear campaign. But when you look at how these massive government tech projects operate, you have to ask whether they are truly serving the traditional values of hardworking families or just expanding state control at the expense of genuine accountability and personal responsibility. We need stability, order, and honest stewardship of public funds, not top-down schemes that trample local trust and bypass traditional community checks and balances.
